phrases.en: I need to report a theft.
phrases.zh: 我要报盗窃案。

phrases.en: My wallet was stolen.
phrases.zh: 我的钱包被偷了。

phrases.en: It happened on the subway.
phrases.zh: 发生在地铁上。

phrases.en: Can I get a police report?
phrases.zh: 能给我报警记录吗？

dialogue.en: What can I do for you?
dialogue.zh: 我能为您做什么？

dialogue.en: I need to report a theft. My wallet was stolen.
dialogue.zh: 我要报盗窃案。我的钱包被偷了。

dialogue.en: Where did it happen?
dialogue.zh: 在哪里发生的？

dialogue.en: It happened on the subway.
dialogue.zh: 发生在地铁上。

dialogue.en: What was in the wallet?
dialogue.zh: 钱包里有什么？

dialogue.en: My ID, two cards, and about a hundred dollars.
dialogue.zh: 身份证、两张卡和大约一百美元。

phrases.en: Someone took my backpack from the café.
phrases.zh: 有人从咖啡店拿走了我的背包。

phrases.en: I saw the person run toward the station.
phrases.zh: 我看到那个人往车站跑了。

phrases.en: Can I file the report in English and Chinese?
phrases.zh: 能用中英文报案吗？

phrases.en: Will I get a copy of the report today?
phrases.zh: 今天能拿到报告副本吗？

phrases.en: Do I need to cancel my cards first?
phrases.zh: 我需要先挂失银行卡吗？

dialogue.en: Someone took my backpack from the café.
dialogue.zh: 有人从咖啡店拿走了我的背包。

dialogue.en: Do you have a description of the person?
dialogue.zh: 您能描述那个人吗？

dialogue.en: I saw the person run toward the station.
dialogue.zh: 我看到那个人往车站跑了。

dialogue.en: What time was that?
dialogue.zh: 几点？

dialogue.en: About ten minutes ago. Can I file the report in English and Chinese?
dialogue.zh: 大约十分钟前。能用中英文报案吗？

dialogue.en: The report will be in English, but I can add a Chinese summary.
dialogue.zh: 报告是英文，但我可以加中文摘要。

dialogue.en: Thank you. Will I get a copy of the report today?
dialogue.zh: 谢谢。今天能拿到报告副本吗？

dialogue.en: I'll email it within an hour.
dialogue.zh: 一小时内发邮件。

dialogue.en: Good. Do I need to cancel my cards first?
dialogue.zh: 好。我需要先挂失银行卡吗？

dialogue.en: Yes, call your bank right away.
dialogue.zh: 需要，马上打给银行。

phrases.en: My passport and laptop were stolen from my rental car. How do I report it?
phrases.zh: 我的护照和电脑从租车里被偷了。怎么报案？

phrases.en: I have the thief on video. Can I send you the footage?
phrases.zh: 我拍到了小偷的视频。能发给你们吗？

phrases.en: The hotel says they can't release the security footage without a police request.
phrases.zh: 酒店说没有警方要求不能提供监控。

phrases.en: I need the report for my insurance claim and passport replacement.
phrases.zh: 我需要报告用于保险理赔和补办护照。

phrases.en: Can you give me a case number I can track online?
phrases.zh: 能给我一个可以在线查询的案件号吗？

dialogue.en: My passport and laptop were stolen from my rental car. How do I report it?
dialogue.zh: 我的护照和电脑从租车里被偷了。怎么报案？

dialogue.en: Don't touch the car. I'll send an officer to dust for prints.
dialogue.zh: 别碰车。我派警员去采集指纹。

dialogue.en: I have the thief on video. Can I send you the footage?
dialogue.zh: 我拍到了小偷的视频。能发给你们吗？

dialogue.en: Upload it to this link and include the case number.
dialogue.zh: 上传到这个链接，附上案件号。

dialogue.en: Okay. The hotel says they can't release the security footage without a police request.
dialogue.zh: 好。酒店说没有警方要求不能提供监控。

dialogue.en: I'll send them a formal request.
dialogue.zh: 我给他们发正式要求。

dialogue.en: Thank you. I need the report for my insurance claim and passport replacement.
dialogue.zh: 谢谢。我需要报告用于保险理赔和补办护照。

dialogue.en: I'll give you a certified copy.
dialogue.zh: 我给您一份认证副本。

dialogue.en: Great. Can you give me a case number I can track online?
dialogue.zh: 好。能给我一个可以在线查询的案件号吗？

dialogue.en: It's on the top of the report.
dialogue.zh: 在报告顶部。

phrases.en: I lost my passport.
phrases.zh: 我的护照丢了。

phrases.en: I need a police report.
phrases.zh: 我需要报警记录。

phrases.en: Where is the Chinese consulate?
phrases.zh: 中国领事馆在哪里？

phrases.en: Can I get an emergency travel document?

dialogue.en: I lost my passport.
dialogue.zh: 我的护照丢了。

dialogue.en: When did you last see it?
dialogue.zh: 最后一次看到是什么时候？

dialogue.en: Yesterday, at the hotel.
dialogue.zh: 昨天，在酒店。

dialogue.en: I'll make a report. You'll need it for the consulate.
dialogue.zh: 我做个记录。领事馆需要。

dialogue.en: Where is the Chinese consulate?
dialogue.zh: 中国领事馆在哪里？

dialogue.en: Downtown, on 12th Street.
dialogue.zh: 市中心，12 街。

phrases.en: My passport was in my bag when it was stolen.
phrases.zh: 我的护照在包里一起被偷了。

phrases.en: Can the consulate issue a replacement in two days?
phrases.zh: 领事馆能两天内补发吗？

phrases.en: Do I need new photos for the application?
phrases.zh: 申请需要新照片吗？

phrases.en: Can I fly domestically without my passport?
phrases.zh: 没有护照能坐国内航班吗？

phrases.en: What documents should I bring to the consulate?
phrases.zh: 去领事馆要带什么文件？

dialogue.en: My passport was in my bag when it was stolen.
dialogue.zh: 我的护照在包里一起被偷了。

dialogue.en: Was anything else taken?
dialogue.zh: 还丢了别的吗？

dialogue.en: My wallet and phone. Can the consulate issue a replacement in two days?
dialogue.zh: 钱包和手机。领事馆能两天内补发吗？

dialogue.en: They can issue an emergency travel document.
dialogue.zh: 他们能办紧急旅行证件。

dialogue.en: Do I need new photos for the application?
dialogue.zh: 申请需要新照片吗？

dialogue.en: Yes, and a copy of the police report.
dialogue.zh: 需要，还要报警记录副本。

dialogue.en: Okay. Can I fly domestically without my passport?
dialogue.zh: 好。没有护照能坐国内航班吗？

dialogue.en: You'll need a government ID or the travel document.
dialogue.zh: 需要政府证件或旅行证件。

dialogue.en: Good. What documents should I bring to the consulate?
dialogue.zh: 好。去领事馆要带什么文件？

dialogue.en: Bring the report, photos, and proof of citizenship.
dialogue.zh: 带报告、照片和国籍证明。

phrases.en: My passport was stolen, and I have a flight in three days. Can the consulate expedite it?
phrases.zh: 我的护照被偷了，三天后有航班。领事馆能加急吗？

phrases.en: I need a police report that states the passport number. Can you include it?
phrases.zh: 我需要写明护照号的报警记录。能加上吗？

phrases.en: Can I travel to Canada with an emergency travel document?
phrases.zh: 能用紧急旅行证件去加拿大吗？

phrases.en: The consulate is closed today. Is there an emergency line?
phrases.zh: 领事馆今天关门。有紧急电话吗？

phrases.en: Can you verify my identity with my Chinese ID card?
phrases.zh: 能用我的中国身份证核实身份吗？

dialogue.en: My passport was stolen, and I have a flight in three days. Can the consulate expedite it?
dialogue.zh: 我的护照被偷了，三天后有航班。领事馆能加急吗？

dialogue.en: I'll mark the report urgent. Call the consulate first thing tomorrow.
dialogue.zh: 我把报告标为加急。明早第一时间打领事馆。

dialogue.en: I will. I need a police report that states the passport number. Can you include it?
dialogue.zh: 好。我需要写明护照号的报警记录。能加上吗？

dialogue.en: I'll add it to the description.
dialogue.zh: 我加到描述里。

dialogue.en: Thank you. Can I travel to Canada with an emergency travel document?
dialogue.zh: 谢谢。能用紧急旅行证件去加拿大吗？

dialogue.en: You'll need to check with Canadian border services.
dialogue.zh: 需要问加拿大边境服务。

dialogue.en: Okay. The consulate is closed today. Is there an emergency line?
dialogue.zh: 好。领事馆今天关门。有紧急电话吗？

dialogue.en: There's a 24-hour line for citizens abroad.
dialogue.zh: 有海外公民二十四小时热线。

dialogue.en: Good. Can you verify my identity with my Chinese ID card?
dialogue.zh: 好。能用我的中国身份证核实身份吗？

dialogue.en: That helps, but the consulate will make the final call.
dialogue.zh: 有帮助，但最终由领事馆决定。

When did you last see it?
asks.zh: 您最后一次看到是什么时候？

reply.en: Chinese. I have a photo on my phone.
reply.zh: 中国籍。我手机里有照片。

listening.pattern: What's your…? / Do you have…? / When did you last…?

asks.en: You'll need a police report for the embassy.
I can give you a copy.

listening.pattern: You'll need… / I can give you… / Take this to…

asks.en: The embassy can issue an emergency passport.
asks.zh: 大使馆可以办临时护照。

reply.en: Yes, I need help with the embassy.
reply.zh: 需要，我需要大使馆方面的帮助。

listening.pattern: The embassy can… / Do you have…? / Do you need…?

phrases.en: I need a copy of the police report.
phrases.zh: 我需要报警记录副本。

phrases.en: My insurance company asked for it.
phrases.zh: 我的保险公司要。

phrases.en: Can you stamp it?
phrases.zh: 能盖章吗？

phrases.en: How long does it take?
phrases.zh: 要多久？

dialogue.en: I need a copy of the police report.
dialogue.zh: 我需要报警记录副本。

dialogue.en: Do you have the case number?
dialogue.zh: 有案件号吗？

dialogue.en: Yes, it's on this card. My insurance company asked for it.
dialogue.zh: 有，在这张卡上。我的保险公司要。

dialogue.en: I'll print a copy.
dialogue.zh: 我打印一份。

dialogue.en: Thanks. Can you stamp it?
dialogue.zh: 谢谢。能盖章吗？

dialogue.en: We don't stamp copies, but I can certify it.
dialogue.zh: 副本不盖章，但我可以认证。

dialogue.en: Good. How long does it take?
dialogue.zh: 好。要多久？

dialogue.en: About ten minutes.
dialogue.zh: 大约十分钟。

phrases.en: Does the report include the value of the stolen items?
phrases.zh: 报告包含被盗物品价值吗？

phrases.en: Can you email the report directly to my insurer?
phrases.zh: 能把报告直接发给我保险公司吗？

phrases.en: I need the officer's name and badge number.
phrases.zh: 我需要警官姓名和警号。

phrases.en: Will the report be available online?
phrases.zh: 报告能在网上查到吗？

phrases.en: Can I get a second copy for the consulate?
phrases.zh: 能再给我一份给领事馆吗？

dialogue.en: Does the report include the value of the stolen items?
dialogue.zh: 报告包含被盗物品价值吗？

dialogue.en: It lists the items and estimated values.
dialogue.zh: 列出了物品和估值。

dialogue.en: Good. Can you email the report directly to my insurer?
dialogue.zh: 好。能把报告直接发给我保险公司吗？

dialogue.en: I can email it to the address you provide.
dialogue.zh: 可以发到您提供的邮箱。

dialogue.en: Thanks. I need the officer's name and badge number.
dialogue.zh: 谢谢。我需要警官姓名和警号。

dialogue.en: It's on the last page.
dialogue.zh: 在最后一页。

dialogue.en: Okay. Will the report be available online?
dialogue.zh: 好。报告能在网上查到吗？

dialogue.en: Only with the case number and your ID.
dialogue.zh: 需要案件号和证件。

dialogue.en: Good. Can I get a second copy for the consulate?
dialogue.zh: 好。能再给我一份给领事馆吗？

dialogue.en: I'll print two.
dialogue.zh: 我打两份。

phrases.en: My insurer requires a notarized police report. Can you provide one?
phrases.zh: 我的保险公司要求公证的报警记录。能提供吗？

phrases.en: The report lists the wrong date. Can you correct it?
phrases.zh: 报告日期写错了。能改吗？

phrases.en: I need the report translated into Chinese for my insurer. Do you have a translation service?
phrases.zh: 我需要把报告翻译成中文给保险公司。你们有翻译服务吗？

phrases.en: The stolen item was a rental laptop. The rental company needs the report too.
phrases.zh: 被偷的是租来的电脑。租车公司也要报告。

phrases.en: Can you confirm the report is complete before I submit it?
phrases.zh: 提交前能确认报告完整吗？

dialogue.en: My insurer requires a notarized police report. Can you provide one?
dialogue.zh: 我的保险公司要求公证的报警记录。能提供吗？

dialogue.en: We can certify it, but notarization is done at a bank.
dialogue.zh: 我们可以认证，但公证要在银行办。

dialogue.en: I see. The report lists the wrong date. Can you correct it?
dialogue.zh: 明白。报告日期写错了。能改吗？

dialogue.en: I'll issue a corrected version.
dialogue.zh: 我出一份更正版。

dialogue.en: Thank you. I need the report translated into Chinese for my insurer. Do you have a translation service?
dialogue.zh: 谢谢。我需要把报告翻译成中文给保险公司。你们有翻译服务吗？

dialogue.en: We don't, but the consulate can recommend one.
dialogue.zh: 我们没有，但领事馆可以推荐。

dialogue.en: Okay. The stolen item was a rental laptop. The rental company needs the report too.
dialogue.zh: 好。被偷的是租来的电脑。租车公司也要报告。

dialogue.en: I'll add them as an interested party.
dialogue.zh: 我把他们加为相关方。

dialogue.en: Great. Can you confirm the report is complete before I submit it?
dialogue.zh: 好。提交前能确认报告完整吗？

dialogue.en: I'll review it with you now.
dialogue.zh: 我现在和您一起核对。
